battle.name: 司馬長安起義
battle.brief: 大業十年（614）冬，隋煬帝遠在江都，雍州（長安）司馬長安殺監軍、據州城起兵，旬月間聚眾數萬，遣使招納關中諸郡，與劉文通部相應，關中震動。隋廷詔以行軍總管楊政率軍入關討平，首領被擒。卡面投石機即此類攻城器械：隋軍沿用前朝發石車、撞車諸具，惟此戰記載未細辨其用。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 司馬長安起義是隋朝末年關中的一次內亂。交戰的一方是起義的雍州官軍與被裹挾的郡縣兵力，另一方是隋廷的中央軍與關中宿衛體系。起義方以司馬長安為首，起事之初不過雍州一州的官屬、屯田戍卒與市井游眾，人數既少，編制也散，多持農具改造的鋤、杵、盾，馬匹極少，遇大軍即潰。事起之後他襲殺州中監軍，奪取兵符印信，以州司馬的職名署置官屬，遣使分往關中諸郡宣告，郡縣吏多觀望，間有開城響應者，眾至數萬，遂與同在關中的劉文通部互相策應，形成對洛陽的側翼之威。隋方則以皇帝詔令為最高指揮，自洛陽與河東發兵，遣行軍總管楊政率關中兵入討，並令潼關、華陰一線的守軍扼住要道，斷絕起義軍與巴蜀、河東的聯絡；朝廷同時對河北、河南其他起義以招撫為先，赦免脅從、懸賞首惡，以免四處同時響應。此役平定之後，隋廷在雍州增置城守與監軍，收緊地方兵權的同時，也把更多的供應與徵發壓在關中肩上。
countriesEn: The Sima Chang'an rising was an internal disturbance in Guanzhong in the closing years of the Sui dynasty. The two sides were, on the one hand, the rebel force raised inside Yong prefecture together with the county levies and garrison troops pressed into its service, and on the other, the Sui central army and the garrison establishment of the Guanzhong capital district. At the outset the rebels were no more than the officials of Yong prefecture, the soldiers of its garrison farms and the idlers of the market towns: few in number, without real organisation, mostly carrying hoes, pestles and improvised shields adapted from farm tools, with almost no cavalry, and they broke up the moment a formed army came against them. Once the revolt began, Sima Chang'an killed the circuit commissioner posted in the prefecture, seized the tally and the seals, used his own office as military deputy of Yong prefecture to appoint officials and set up a staff, and sent envoys to the various commanderies of Guanzhong to proclaim the rising. County officials mostly watched and waited, a few opened their gates and joined, and the crowd swelled to several tens of thousands within a month, so that his movement began to coordinate with the band of Liu Wentong operating elsewhere in Guanzhong, threatening Luoyang on its western flank. On the Sui side the supreme direction of the war lay with the emperor's own edicts: troops were dispatched from Luoyang and Hedong, with Yang Zheng sent as chief commander of the field army to enter Guanzhong and suppress the revolt, while the garrisons on the line of Tongguan and Huayin were ordered to hold the key passes and cut the rebels off from Ba-Shu and Hedong. At the same time the court treated the risings in Hebei and Henan with a policy of amnesty first, pardoning those who had been coerced and posting rewards for the leaders of the trouble, so that the provinces would not rise all at once. After the revolt was put down, the court added watchmen and circuit commissioners in Yong prefecture; in tightening control over local arms it also pressed a heavier burden of supply and levies onto Guanzhong.
people: 司馬長安是本役的核心人物，關中扶風人，在隋為雍州司馬一級的州府官員，位卑而熟悉州郡兵與屯田戶的實情。他並非世族領袖，起義時所憑的不是血統而是對地方兵籍戶貫的掌握：能點起一批可以說服的戍卒與逃籍之徒，也能算清關中糧秣與城防空隙。關中另一名武裝首領劉文通在此役中與他並起，兩部在隋廷鎮壓下先合後散，劉文通殘部在關中堅持到隋亡前一歲，被唐軍在渭北打散，部將龐玉在介休被斬，可見此役餘波一直延到隋唐交替之際。隋煬帝楊廣本人遠在江都，只能靠詔書遙控關中，聽聞雍州失守而震怒，即刻遣將討平；負責執行的是行軍總管楊政，他不作緩兵持久之計，率軍直趨州城，短時間內結束戰事，首領被擒。郡縣官吏多在其中兩面周旋，既怕朝廷追究失守，又懼起義軍勢大，多以觀望自保，其人其事在史籍中多所諱飾，因此本役的具體指揮鏈條至今仍難以完整還原。
peopleEn: Sima Chang'an was the central figure of the affair, a native of Fufeng in Guanzhong who served the Sui as a prefecture-level official of the rank of military deputy of Yong. Low in office but intimate with the actual state of the prefecture's soldiers and of the garrison-farm households, he was no hereditary leader: what he could rely on was not blood but his grasp of the local military registers and of where the men and grain lay. He could raise a body of garrison conscripts and men who had fled the registers, and he could calculate the gaps in the grain supply and in the defence of the walled towns. Liu Wentong, the other armed leader in Guanzhong, rose at the same time; the two bands were first drawn together and then divided by Sui suppression, and Liu's remnants held out in Guanzhong until the year before the Sui fell, when Tang forces scattered them in northern Shaanxi and his commander Pang Yu was cut down at Jiexiu. The echo of this revolt thus ran right up to the handover between Sui and Tang. Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, was himself far away at Jiangdu and could direct Guanzhong only by edict; when he learned that Yong had been lost he was furious and sent a general to end the matter at once. The man who carried the order out was the chief commander of the field army, Yang Zheng, who avoided any protracted campaign, marched straight for the prefectural city, closed the affair within a short time, and had the rebel leader taken. The county officials steered between the two sides throughout: afraid of being called to account for the loss of their posts, yet unwilling to face a rebel host that was still growing, most of them waited and watched. Their names and their actions are largely suppressed in the surviving histories, which is why the exact chain of command in this rising can still not be fully reconstructed.
kits: 卡面這件投石機，即古代羅馬的扭力式拋石器，前身可溯至公元前三世紀的攻城戰，結構上以車架、絞盤、彈簧臂與彈藥槽組成，把人力絞盤的勢能一次轉換成石彈的初速，射程數十至數百步不等，是當時唯一能把破壞力以可計算方式投向城牆的攻城器械。進入中國後，它在漢末曹操的發石車、曹魏的霹靂車一系之下演為隋唐史籍中所稱的發石車或砲：木臂以繩索絞蓄，擊發時繩斷、臂彈，一發可毀垣牆、砸屋舍、壓制城頭守軍。隋承北周制度，軍器監造具冊，發石車與撞車、雲梯、鉤援之具同列攻城之具，長安、洛陽的城守也以女牆、馬面、敵樓與弩機應對。這一場起義本身是關中州城之爭，現存記載只留下襲殺監軍、據城聚眾與官軍入關討平這樣的骨架，並無逐具器械的描寫，故無法斷定發石車曾否實際用於此役；可以確定的是，攻城與守城的器械體系正是隋廷必須把雍州控制在自己手裡的理由之一：關中一旦為亂，長安一城之得失就會牽動整個關中兵源的徵發與輸漕。
kitsEn: The card shows an onager, the Roman traction stone-thrower whose ancestors can be traced to the siege warfare of the third century BC. Its frame carried a winch, a spring arm and a ammunition trough, converting at one stroke the potential energy stored by human muscle into the muzzle velocity of a stone; its range ran from several dozen to several hundred paces, and it was the one siege engine of its day that could deliver a calculable amount of destruction against a curtain wall. Once it reached China it passed through the line of Cao Cao's fashiche of the late Han and the Cao Wei thunder-throwers, and appears in Sui and Tang sources under the names fashiche, or pao: a wooden arm wound up by ropes, released when the cord was cut, so that a single shot could shatter walling, crush buildings and sweep the defenders off the parapet. The Sui inherited the Northern Zhou system, with the Directorate for the Manufacture of Arms keeping an inventory in which the stone-thrower stood beside battering rams, scaling ladders and hooked poles, while the defences of Chang'an and Luoyang answered them with parapets, horse-faced walls, guard towers and crossbow engines. This rising in its own right was a struggle over a prefectural city in Guanzhong, and the surviving record preserves only a skeleton: the killing of the circuit commissioner, the occupation of the city and the gathering of a multitude, followed by the entry of the government army into Guanzhong to end it. There is no description of the engines one by one, so it cannot be said whether a stone-thrower was actually used in this particular action. What can be said is that the siege and siege-defence repertoire was one of the reasons the Sui court had to keep Yong prefecture firmly in its own hands: once Guanzhong was in turmoil, the fate of a single city at Chang'an would drag with it the whole region's levy system and grain traffic.
tactics: 起義軍的戰法是典型的先取城、後圖援。司馬長安選擇隋煬帝遠在江都、關中宿衛調離的時機，以驟然發難的方式控制州城與城門，奪取兵械與糧秣，然後據城固守，派使者往來關中各郡宣告，試圖以政治號召代替正面會戰；其部眾多為徒眾，陣形不整，缺乏騎兵，遇精兵鋒便解體，因此全役沒有大型野戰，主要動作是襲城、守城與擴散聯絡。劉文通部則在關中另一方向遊擊，令隋軍不能專注一處。隋軍的戰術與之相反：主力不與叛軍糾纏，選擇秋冬道路可通、糧道可恃的季節直趨長安，以精兵銳卒先取要害，抵達之後即行合圍，先斷城內外通訊，再迫令首領與骨幹出降；同時分兵守住潼關、華陰與渭水下游的渡口，形成對關中各城的監視，斷其與河東、巴蜀的呼應，又在沿線設置烽燧與驛傳，使京師與雍州之間的調兵不致失去聯繫。攻城若要強行，隋軍尚有發石車、撞車、雲梯與穴地諸法可施，但從結果看，隋廷顯然選擇了速戰速決與招撫並行，以免長期圍城反過來斷了關中的漕運與徵兵。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the rebels followed the classic pattern of seizing the city first and seeking reinforcements afterwards. Sima Chang'an chose the moment when Emperor Yang was far away at Jiangdu and the garrison of Guanzhong had been drawn away, seized the prefectural city and its gates in a sudden outbreak, took the arms and the grain, then sat tight in the city and sent envoys to and fro among the commanderies of Guanzhong, trying to substitute political proclamation for pitched battle. His followers were in the main a raw multitude: their formations were unsteady, they had no cavalry, and they dissolved before formed troops, which is why the whole affair produced no large-scale field engagement, the main actions being the seizure of the city, its defence and the spread of the network of envoys. Liu Wentong's band meanwhile harried another part of Guanzhong, preventing the Sui army from concentrating on a single point. The Sui doctrine was the exact opposite. The main force avoided prolonged entanglement with the rebels, chose the autumn and winter season, when the roads were passable and the supply lines could be relied upon, and drove straight for Chang'an with picked troops taking the vital points first; on arrival it invested the city at once, cut communications between town and countryside, and then forced the leader and the core of the rebels to surrender. At the same time detachments were posted to hold Tongguan, Huayin and the fords below the Wei, keeping watch over the towns of Guanzhong and cutting the rebels off from Hedong and Ba-Shu, while beacon towers and courier stations along the route kept the dispatch of troops between the capital and Yong prefecture from ever going blind. If a forcible assault had been needed, the Sui still had the stone-throwers, battering rams, scaling ladders and mine digging at its disposal; but from the outcome it is clear the court chose speed and a mixture of force and amnesty, so that a long siege would not instead sever the grain traffic and the levies of Guanzhong.
data: 可用的數字多來自《隋書》《資治通鑑》與《隋書·食貨志》一類文獻，需要分辨哪些屬實、哪些只是約數。時間上，此役屬隋煬帝大業十年（614），起於該年冬，旬月之間即告平定，歷時不足兩月。背景數字更可觀：同在這幾年，隋廷仍在經營征高句麗之役，通鑑記載大業十一年發兵三十萬五千，連同諸王國與蕃部兵合計近五十萬，而前線戰死與染疫失亡的比例高達十四五；河南一帶因大業九年調發民夫渡河役使，運糧船隻在黎陽一線漂失，役者死者數萬。戶籍方面，大業中天下戶約八百九十萬，而關中因早年配戶實邊，戶口兼併與逃亡最為嚴重，一州之兵不足以久守一州之眾。城池尺度上，隋都大興城牆周長逾八十里，雍州治所雖非京城，卻是關中漕運與兵源的節點，長安至洛陽經潼關的道路約七八百里。起義軍本身的確切人數史無明文，通行說法是旬月之間聚眾數萬，兵械多由民間取給，故其戰力更接近能擾亂一州的暴民，而非能與官軍野戰的軍隊。
dataEn: The usable figures come mostly from documents such as the History of Sui, the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance and the Food and Revenue treatise of the History of Sui, and each has to be sorted into what is attested and what is merely an approximation. As to time, the rising belongs to the tenth year of the Daye era, 614, began in the winter of that year and was settled within a month, so that the whole business lasted less than two months. The background figures are more substantial. In these same years the Sui court was still fighting the campaigns against Goguryeo, and the Mirror records that in the eleventh year of Daye it mustered 305,000 men, with the armies of the princely houses and of the tribal peoples bringing the total to close on half a million, while the proportion of the front line lost to battle and to disease reached seven or eight men in ten. In Henan, when the labourers were levied to cross the river in the ninth year of Daye, the grain-carrying boats went down in the neighbourhood of Liyang and tens of thousands of the men engaged perished. On registers, the empire counted in the region of 8.9 million households during Daye, but Guanzhong, which had received paired households settled on the frontier in the earlier decades, suffered the worst flight and concentration of land, so that the troops of a single prefecture could not long hold a single prefecture's population. As to the size of the cities, the walls of the Sui capital Daxing ran for more than eighty li around, and although the seat of Yong prefecture was not the capital, it was the node of Guanzhong's grain traffic and of its manpower; the road from Chang'an to Luoyang through Tongguan ran for some seven or eight hundred li. The exact number of the rebels is not stated in the histories; the usual account is that several tens of thousands gathered within a month, with arms taken from private hands, so that their fighting power was closer to a mob able to disturb one prefecture than to an army that could meet the government in the open field.
cause: 起義的根由不在一人一地，而在隋朝晚年整體的財政與役政崩壞。連年征高句麗，把河南、河北的丁口與糧運抽空；大業九年河南諸郡男女百餘萬人被徵渡河役使，運糧船隻在黎陽一線漂失，役者死者數萬，中原免租調之民反而重複承擔徭役，怨氣由此積累。山東、河北先後有王薄、張金通、竇建德、杜伏威等部起事，隋廷用重兵逐次平壓，關中又長期承擔首都圈的供給與宿衛之累；雍州作為京畿重鎮，官吏與屯田戶之間的分配矛盾尤其尖銳，配戶之民不堪役使，本地士紳則挾其財勢觀望。司馬長安起兵之所以能一舉成事，正因為大業十年冬隋煬帝仍在江都一線，中央對關中的監察與控制最為薄弱，雍州監軍與州府之間的權柄爭鬥又為他提供了可乘之機；地方上已有人公開鼓吹隋室失德，關中民間則把兵變視為避役與避罪的出路，起義一旦起頭，招募的速度便遠遠超過朝廷作出反應的速度。
causeEn: The root of the rising lay neither in one man nor in one place, but in the general breakdown of Sui finances and corvée administration in the last years of the dynasty. The repeated campaigns against Goguryeo drained away the households and the grain traffic of Henan and Hebei. In the ninth year of Daye more than a million men and women from the commanderies of Henan were levied to cross the river; the grain boats went down around Liyang and tens of thousands of those set to work perished. Men whose taxes and levies had been remitted found themselves carrying the burden of labour a second time, and resentment accumulated accordingly. In Shandong and Hebei the bands of Wang Bo, Zhang Jintong, Dou Jiande and Du Fuwei had already risen one after another, and the court crushed them in turn with heavy armies, while Guanzhong bore the long burden of supplying and billeting the capital district. Yong, the prefecture nearest the seat of government, saw the sharpest conflict between officials and garrison-farm households: the resettled men could no longer bear the labour levy, while the local gentry sat on their wealth and watched. The reason Sima Chang'an could bring his rising off in a single stroke is that in the winter of the tenth year of Daye Emperor Yang was still on the Jiangdu side of the empire, and the central court's supervision and control of Guanzhong was at its weakest, while the quarrel for authority between the circuit commissioner and the prefectural administration of Yong gave him his opening. There were already people openly preaching that the Sui house had forfeited its virtue, and the people of Guanzhong began to read a mutiny as a way to escape both labour and punishment. Once the rising had started, the speed of recruitment outran the speed at which the court could respond.
impact: 此役雖短，卻是隋末崩解次序上的重要一環。它說明大業十年的關中已不再可靠：中央對雍州的控制要靠一名總管率兵入關才得以恢復，而恢復之後的辦法不是解散地方武裝，反而是加設監軍、增戍卒、加重關中的供應，使同一矛盾在原地累積。從更大的戰略看，隋廷把關中兵力和注意力釘在雍州，就等於放棄用關中兵去救河北與江淮的機會；同年河北的竇建德與江淮的杜伏威得以坐大，正是這種取捨的結果。對關中自身，這場起義留下一支不肯解散的武裝，劉文通部在關中堅持到隋亡前一年，唐軍於渭北用一場短促的野戰才把他打散，說明關中的反隋力量並未隨司馬長安被誅而消失，隋唐之際的爭奪在關中先打了整整四年。對後世治史者，這一役也是觀察隋代地方軍制與監軍制度的窗口：州級司馬能憑一枚州印起兵，而中央的處置卻是換將而非改制，反映出隋朝以監軍牽制州府的脆弱平衡。
impactEn: Short as it was, this rising matters for the sequence in which the Sui order came apart. It showed that Guanzhong could no longer be relied upon in the tenth year of Daye: the centre could recover control of Yong only by sending a commander in with an army, and the remedy it chose afterwards was not to disband the local armed forces but to add circuit commissioners, to increase the garrison and to lay a heavier supply burden on Guanzhong, so that the same contradiction grew in place. On the wider strategic plane, pinning Guanzhong's troops and attention to Yong meant surrendering any chance of using Guanzhong's army to save Hebei or the Jianghuai; that Dou Jiande in Hebei and Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai were able to grow at large in the same year was the direct result of that choice. For Guanzhong itself, the rising left behind an armed body that refused to dissolve: Liu Wentong's band held the region until the year before the Sui fell, and it took a short field battle in northern Shaanxi to scatter it, which shows that the anti-Sui strength of Guanzhong did not vanish with the execution of Sima Chang'an. The contest between Sui and Tang was fought in Guanzhong for four full years before it was decided elsewhere. For later historians the episode is also a window onto Sui military administration and the circuit commissioner system: a prefecture-level deputy could raise a revolt with nothing but a prefectural seal, and the centre's answer was to change the commander rather than to change the system, revealing how fragile was the Sui balance of power in which circuit commissioners held local officials in check.
result: 起義的結局是失敗：州城被隋軍奪回，司馬長安所聚的徒眾在官軍抵達後迅速瓦解，一部分散去為盜，一部分歸降，骨幹首領被擒獲，據隋書所記在北京師就刑，一說陣亡於關中。劉文通部未被併滅，帶著殘餘人馬退守關中另一側，成為隋廷在關中長期不能根除的隱患。對隋朝本身，此役是一次成功的鎮壓，卻不是一次成功的治理：雍州恢復了秩序，起義軍散了，糧冊與兵籍卻在戰亂與徵發中被重新登記，關中百姓的役負並未因此減輕，隨著大業十一年冬隋煬帝再舉兵征高句麗、抽取關中丁壯，關中地區的不滿再度上升，兩年後河南、江淮、關中同時崩解，隋朝在關中被反過來吞沒。
resultEn: The rising ended in failure. The prefectural city was taken back by the Sui army; the multitude Sima Chang'an had gathered dissolved quickly once the government troops arrived, some dispersing as bandits, some surrendering, and the core of the leadership was taken prisoner. The History of Sui records that the chief was executed in the capital, while another account has him falling in the fighting in Guanzhong. Liu Wentong's band was not swallowed up; it withdrew with its remnants to another part of Guanzhong and became a trouble the Sui court could not root out there for a long time. For the Sui state the episode was a successful suppression but not a successful governance. Order returned to Yong and the rebels scattered, yet the grain registers and the military rolls were redrawn by the fighting and the levies, and the labour burden on the people of Guanzhong was not lightened by any of it. When in the winter of the eleventh year of Daye Emperor Yang once more mustered an army against Goguryeo and drew away the strong men of Guanzhong, discontent in the region rose again, and two years later Henan, the Jianghuai and Guanzhong all broke down together. The Sui was swallowed at last by the region it had just put down in arms.
